items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: Me and Greg, Michael White, and Steve Bailock on guitar.

ctx.x: Meaning what, why? To us, you know. I mean we used to get a lot of whippings.

Like for instance we had a dog, we used to call him Jelly Bean, you know. And my job was to keep the dog supplied with water, you know. Right. And like if one time like I forget or something and he come see the parent after the evening, whip me, you know. I'm talking about, you know, I like children whip me in children now, you know. Right. Yeah. And matter of fact, if, if they had 911, you know, like these kids calling 911 then, you know, child abuse, that my dad would stay in jail. Yeah. You know, with Steve, I…
So you didn't look at that he was really disciplining you, he was, it was.
